slides.narration: Chapter 15: The Coupling Constants. The strengths of all three fundamental forces — electromagnetic, strong, and weak — are derived from the tower's screening structure with zero adjustable parameters.

The fine-structure constant — the strength of the electromagnetic force — comes out to one over 137.036, matching the measured value to eight significant figures. This is not a fit. It is a derivation from the tower's screening depth, with no knobs to turn.

All three forces are different views of the same tower. The electromagnetic force is screened through six full stages. The strong force couples through the three bridges. The weak force through the shortest available path. One screening ratio D, three different path lengths, three different coupling strengths.
